notes:
# New

### General
* `findall` now correctly shows the final item count message after displaying all characters, and no longer prints item names in random order.

### Inventory & Library
* Added the ability to search & filter by equipment stats in both views.
* Added the ability to search by multiple keywords using either `|` or `,` delimiters.

### Auction House
* The Incremental Bid window now defaults to the currently selected character.  (Thanks to @Nagumo)
* When doing a multi-buy operation, Alexandria will automatically stop if the bid is ever rejected.  (Thanks to @Nagumo)

### Delivery Box
* Added an "Enable POLSendable Items" setting that lets you mail POLSendable items. Since Alexandria currently has no way to know which characters belong to which account, it just allows sending to any character previously registered with Alexandria. Please use carefully.
* Added a Collect All function to both the inbox and outbox.

### Augmentation (Ambuscade)
* Added a "Bulk Trade Materials" setting that causes Alexandria to attempt to trade the maximum amount of materials to complete an item per augment stat, rather than one material at a time.
* Added a "Materials Applied So Far" function which attempts to detect the progress of partially augmented Ambuscade capes and prevents using materials where the stat is already maxed. This is a best-effort estimate, so you can manually correct any material's count if needed.

### Organize
* Added an "Only Organize Tagged Items" toggle which restricts Organize to only moving tagged items.

### Gear Pull
* Gear Pull presets can now be restricted to specific jobs when enabling the "auto pull on jobchange" function.

### Consolidate
* Added the ability to exclude specific characters as consolidate targets under Consolidate > Exceptions.

### Drop List
* Added the ability to sort by Alphabetical or Value.

### Sell List
* Added the ability to bulk delete items from the Sell List.

### Currency & Key Items
* Multiple key item/currency entries can now be expanded simultaneously. (Thanks to @Nagumo)

# Bugfixes
* Fixed an issue where the Sparks/Unity conversion feature would sometimes not sell items automatically unless the user opened a shop.
